description: AEM Cloud Service code quality rules, forbidden APIs, deprecated patterns, and path restrictions. Based on Cloud Manager CodeQuality-rules-latest-CS.xlsx and Adobe Experience League documentation.

categories.name: INTERNAL_API
categories.description: Internal implementation APIs that are not part of the public API
categories.replacement: Use public API interfaces instead of implementation classes

categories.name: DEPRECATED_REPLICATION
categories.replacement: Use Sling Content Distribution API (org.apache.sling.distribution)

categories.name: DEPRECATED_WORKFLOW
categories.description: Deprecated workflow APIs - use Sling Jobs instead
categories.replacement: Use org.apache.sling.event.jobs.JobManager for background processing

categories.name: ADMIN_SESSION
categories.description: Administrative session methods that bypass ACLs
categories.replacement: Use service users with ServiceUserMapped interface

categories.name: DEPRECATED_QUERY
categories.replacement: Use QueryBuilder API or Oak index-based queries

categories.name: CLASSIC_UI
categories.replacement: Use Touch UI / Coral UI components

categories.name: DEPRECATED_DAM
categories.replacement: Use Asset Compute microservices for rendition processing

categories.name: DEPRECATED_TAGGING
categories.replacement: Use cq:tags property directly or new Tagging API

categories.name: SCHEDULER_DIRECT
categories.description: Direct scheduler usage without distributed coordination
categories.replacement: Use Sling Jobs with proper distributed locking for cluster-safe scheduling

categories.name: DEPRECATED_AUTH
categories.replacement: Use IMS authentication and service users

categories.name: DEPRECATED_SOCIAL
categories.replacement: AEM Communities is deprecated - use third-party solutions

categories.name: DEPRECATED_SCENE7
categories.replacement: Use Dynamic Media with OpenAPI delivery

categories.name: LOCAL_BINARY_STORAGE
categories.description: Direct binary storage access (not compatible with cloud storage)
categories.replacement: Use standard JCR Binary API - cloud uses blob storage

categories.name: SERVLET_DEPRECATED
categories.replacement: Use Sling Model Exporter or specific HTTP method servlets

categories.name: PROVIDER_TYPE_IMPLEMENTATION
categories.description: Customer code implementing or extending @ProviderType APIs
categories.replacement: Never implement @ProviderType interfaces - use them as provided by AEM

categories.name: THREAD_UNSAFE_FIELDS
categories.description: Non-thread-safe objects stored as class fields
categories.replacement: Obtain these objects fresh for each request - do not store as class fields

categories.name: UNCLOSED_RESOURCE_RESOLVER
categories.replacement: Always close ResourceResolver using try-with-resources or explicit close()

categories.name: HTTP_CLIENT_TIMEOUT
categories.replacement: Configure socket and connect timeouts (60 seconds or less)

categories.name: SERVLET_PATH_BINDING
categories.description: Servlets registered by path instead of resource type
categories.replacement: Register servlets by resource type using sling.servlet.resourceTypes

categories.name: DANGEROUS_THREAD_METHODS
categories.replacement: Use message passing and cooperative thread termination patterns

categories.name: CONSOLE_OUTPUT
categories.description: Direct console output instead of logging
categories.replacement: Use SLF4J logging framework

categories.name: HARDCODED_PATHS
categories.replacement: Use relative paths or resource type resolution

categories.name: SLING_SCHEDULER_DIRECT
categories.replacement: Use Sling Jobs API for guaranteed cluster-safe execution

categories.name: INJECT_WITH_OPTIONAL
categories.replacement: Use specific injectors like @ValueMapValue or @OsgiInjector

categories.name: HTTP_CLIENT_REUSE
categories.description: HTTPClient instances created per-method instead of reused
categories.replacement: Create HTTPClient at class level and reuse across method calls

categories.name: SUPPLY_CHAIN_PROCESS_SPAWN
categories.description: OS process spawning inside an OSGi bundle is a supply chain attack indicator. AEM bundles have no legitimate reason to fork processes.
categories.replacement: Use Sling Jobs (org.apache.sling.event.jobs.JobManager) for async/background work.

categories.name: SUPPLY_CHAIN_REMOTE_CLASSLOAD
categories.description: Loading classes from remote URLs at runtime bypasses OSGi's class-visibility contract and is a classic supply chain backdoor delivery mechanism.
categories.replacement: Declare all required packages in OSGi Import-Package. Use @Reference for service lookup.

categories.name: SUPPLY_CHAIN_REFLECTION_LOAD
categories.description: Class.forName() with a dynamic or encoded class name is used in supply chain attacks to load payloads without static imports. Prefer explicit @Reference injection.
categories.replacement: Use explicit class references or @Reference/@Inject for OSGi/Sling service lookup.

sonarQubeRules.name: Do not use potentially dangerous functions
sonarQubeRules.description: Methods like Thread.stop() create hard-to-reproduce issues

sonarQubeRules.name: Do not use format strings that may be externally controlled
sonarQubeRules.description: External format strings can cause denial of service attacks

sonarQubeRules.name: HTTP requests should always have socket and connect timeouts
sonarQubeRules.description: HTTP timeouts must be 60 seconds or less

sonarQubeRules.name: Do not use Sling servlet paths to register servlets
sonarQubeRules.description: Path-bound servlets bypass standard JCR access controls

sonarQubeRules.name: Caught exceptions should be logged or thrown, not both
sonarQubeRules.description: Avoid duplicate log entries from logging and throwing

sonarQubeRules.name: Avoid logging at INFO when handling GET or HEAD requests
sonarQubeRules.description: Use DEBUG or TRACE for GET/HEAD; reserve INFO for state-changing ops

sonarQubeRules.name: Do not print stack traces to the console
sonarQubeRules.description: Use logging framework instead of printStackTrace()

sonarQubeRules.name: Avoid hardcoded apps and libs paths
sonarQubeRules.description: Use relative paths instead of absolute /libs and /apps paths

sonarQubeRules.name: Do not use Sling scheduler
sonarQubeRules.description: Use Sling Jobs for guaranteed cluster-safe execution

sonarQubeRules.name: Do not use Experience Manager deprecated APIs
sonarQubeRules.description: Replace deprecated APIs with supported alternatives

sonarQubeRules.name: Do not use Experience Manager deprecated APIs
sonarQubeRules.description: AEM-specific deprecated APIs no longer recommended

sonarQubeRules.name: Do not use @Inject annotation with @Optional in Sling Models
Reuse instances of a HTTPClient
sonarQubeRules.description: Create HTTPClient at class level to minimize overhead

oakPalRules.name: Do not implement or extend @ProviderType APIs
oakPalRules.description: Never implement interfaces marked @ProviderType

oakPalRules.name: Custom Lucene Oak indexes must have a Tika configuration
oakPalRules.description: Include tika node with config.xml for damAssetLucene, lucene, or graphqlConfig

oakPalRules.name: Custom Lucene Oak Indexes must not be synchronous
oakPalRules.description: Set async property on all lucene type indexes

oakPalRules.name: Custom DAM Asset Lucene Oak indexes must be properly structured
oakPalRules.description: Include tags property with visualSimilaritySearch in damAssetLucene

oakPalRules.name: Customer packages should not create or modify nodes under libs
oakPalRules.description: Never modify /libs content

oakPalRules.name: Packages should not contain duplicate OSGi configurations
oakPalRules.description: Same OSGi component should not be configured multiple times

oakPalRules.name: Config and install folders should only contain OSGi nodes
oakPalRules.description: Restrict /config/ and /install/ to OSGi configurations and bundles

oakPalRules.name: Packages should not overlap
oakPalRules.description: Avoid multiple packages writing to same node paths

oakPalRules.name: The default authoring mode should not be classic UI
oakPalRules.description: Configure Touch UI as default authoring mode

oakPalRules.name: Components with dialogs should have Touch UI dialogs
oakPalRules.description: Provide Touch UI dialogs for all Classic UI dialogs

oakPalRules.name: Packages should not mix mutable and immutable content
oakPalRules.description: Separate /apps, /libs content from other repository areas

oakPalRules.name: Do not use reverse replication agents
oakPalRules.description: Reverse replication not supported in Cloud Service

oakPalRules.name: Proxy-enabled clientlib resources should be in resources folder
oakPalRules.description: Place static assets in resources subfolder for proxy-enabled clientlibs

oakPalRules.name: Usage of Cloud Service incompatible workflow processes
oakPalRules.description: Update deprecated asset workflows to use asset micro-services

oakPalRules.name: Usage of static templates is discouraged
oakPalRules.description: Migrate static templates to editable templates

oakPalRules.name: Usage of legacy foundation components is discouraged
oakPalRules.description: Replace Foundation Components with Core Components

oakPalRules.name: Only use supported run mode names and ordering
oakPalRules.description: Follow official run mode naming and ordering conventions

oakPalRules.name: Index definitions must be direct children of /oak:index
oakPalRules.description: Place index definitions only as direct children of /oak:index

oakPalRules.name: Index definitions must have compatVersion of 2
oakPalRules.description: Set compatVersion property to 2

oakPalRules.name: Index descendant nodes must be nt:unstructured
oakPalRules.description: Use only nt:unstructured for child nodes under index definitions

oakPalRules.name: Index definitions must contain indexRules with children
oakPalRules.description: Include indexRules node with at least one child

oakPalRules.name: Index definitions must use Lucene index type
oakPalRules.description: Use only Lucene index type

oakPalRules.name: Index definitions must not contain seed property
oakPalRules.description: Remove seed property from custom index definitions

oakPalRules.name: Index definitions must not contain reindex property
oakPalRules.description: Remove reindex property from custom index definitions

oakPalRules.name: Index definitions must not be in UI content package
oakPalRules.description: Deploy custom index definitions in code packages

oakPalRules.name: Certain out-of-the-box index definitions cannot be customized
oakPalRules.description: Cannot customize: nodetypeLucene, slingResourceResolver, socialLucene, appsLibsLucene, authorizables, pathReference

oakPalRules.name: Tokenizers must use the name 'tokenizer'
oakPalRules.description: Name tokenizer configurations exactly 'tokenizer'

aemSonarQubeRules.name: Hardcoded Constants in Annotations
aemSonarQubeRules.description: Replace inline literals with predefined AEM constants

aemSonarQubeRules.name: Hardcoded Values
aemSonarQubeRules.description: Use AEM-provided constants instead of repeating values

aemSonarQubeRules.name: Non-Thread-Safe Session Objects as Fields
aemSonarQubeRules.description: Do not store ResourceResolver, Session, PageManager as class fields

aemSonarQubeRules.name: Null Check getContentResource()
aemSonarQubeRules.description: Always null check the return value of getContentResource()

aemSonarQubeRules.name: ResourceResolver Cleanup
aemSonarQubeRules.description: ResourceResolver life cycle ends with calling close()

aemSonarQubeRules.name: Session Logout
aemSonarQubeRules.description: Manual sessions must be logged out to release resources

aemSonarQubeRules.name: Deprecated Admin Access
aemSonarQubeRules.description: Do not use getAdministrativeResourceResolver or loginAdministrative

aemSonarQubeRules.name: Avoid Synchronized Keyword
aemSonarQubeRules.description: Avoid synchronization when alternative solutions exist

aemSonarQubeRules.name: ModifiableValueMap Usage
aemSonarQubeRules.description: Replace with ValueMap if no mutation methods used

aemSonarQubeRules.name: Explicit Search Strategy
aemSonarQubeRules.description: Define search strategy explicitly in Sling Query

contentPatterns.recommendation: Use Asset Compute for rendition processing

Overly permissive ACL - avoid granting jcr:all permissions
Admin user reference - use dedicated service users instead

dispatcherRules.name: Missing filter section
dispatcherRules.description: Dispatcher configuration should have a /filter section to control access

dispatcherRules.name: Missing default deny rule
dispatcherRules.description: Filter section should start with a deny-all rule, then selectively allow paths

dispatcherRules.name: Dangerous extension allowed
dispatcherRules.description: Extensions like .json, .xml, .infinity should be denied or restricted

dispatcherRules.name: Dangerous selector allowed
dispatcherRules.description: Selectors like .feed, .infinity should be denied to prevent data exposure

dispatcherRules.name: Administrative path allowed
dispatcherRules.description: Paths like /crx, /system, /admin should never be exposed through dispatcher

dispatcherRules.name: Overly permissive allow rule
dispatcherRules.description: Avoid allow rules that match all URLs - use specific path patterns

dispatcherRules.name: No HTTP method filtering
dispatcherRules.description: Consider restricting allowed HTTP methods to GET/HEAD for static content

dispatcherRules.name: No query string filtering
dispatcherRules.description: Add query/suffix filtering to prevent cache poisoning attacks

dispatcherRules.name: Syndication propagation enabled
dispatcherRules.description: Syndication propagation should only be enabled for content sync scenarios
